description: Canonical error responses. Any provider of this contract -- the harness fake or a real implementation -- must produce exactly these shapes for these situations. request_id varies per request and is compared for presence, not value.

cases.name: unauthenticated
cases.situation: No server-side identity is available (DEV_PERSONA_MODE=off and M01 not integrated).

cases.name: client_asserted_identity
cases.situation: Request carried X-School-Id. Rejected, not ignored.

cases.name: stale_two_factor
cases.situation: Teacher T1 attempts a write with 2FA asserted more than 15 minutes ago.

cases.name: action_denied
cases.situation: Guardian G2 reads a note about student S1, whom G2 does not guard.

cases.name: cross_school_is_not_found
cases.situation: A School A actor reads a School B note. MUST be 404, never 403, so probing cannot distinguish 'exists but not yours' from 'does not exist'.

cases.name: version_conflict
cases.situation: expected_version=1 sent against a note already at version 2.

cases.name: server_internal_field_rejected
cases.situation: Request body contained resource_grant, which is minted server-side only.

cases.name: malformed_cursor
cases.situation: A hand-edited or foreign cursor. Must be 422 at the boundary, never a 500.
